scope: Recorded single-step controller regressions with explicit state/envelope fixtures; not a complete camera-to-UART or physical vehicle replay.

reconstruction.envelope_mode: Logged baseline oracle; candidate arc checks controlled separately
reconstruction.lookahead_mode: Recorded lookahead supplied explicitly; do not invent filter history
reconstruction.motion_mode: Body twist reconstructed algebraically; no optical-flow pixels replayed
reconstruction.state_mode: Prior publication/velocity from trace; applied regulator mean from current CONTROL when available, otherwise inverse-boost rounded prior base PWM
